scenarios.title: Theo: before hand-off to Reviewer, render all ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9) and attach safe-area contact sheet
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/theo.md (Rules from failed reviews, PAR-3608): Crop and safe-area check: before a creative goes to the critic, render every delivered ratio (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9) and the thumbnail, and confirm the full product name, the hook line and the CTA sit inside each crop's safe area.
scenarios.situation: You are Theo, Ad Creative Maker. You have finished a Velox hero video asset in 9:16 format. The product name, the hook line ('Master multiplication in 10 minutes'), and the CTA button are rendered in the video. You're ready to hand off to the Reviewer for scoring.
scenarios.task: Do you hand it off immediately with the 9:16 file? Or do you render it in all ratios and confirm the critical text sits safe?

forbid.reason: do not ask for safe-area check; render and attach it before hand-off

plan.say: Generated contact sheet: all 5 crops (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, thumbnail). Verified in each: 'Velox' logo, hook 'Master multiplication in 10 minutes', CTA 'Try free' all sit inside safe margins. Attached contact sheet to this comment.

pass.summary: Safe-area contact sheet attached before hand-off.

plan.say: Video ready in 9:16. Handing off to the Reviewer for scoring. The assets cover the product features clearly.

scenarios.title: Theo: every claim in ad copy must have a Drive file link to its source before going to Reviewer
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/theo.md (Rules from failed reviews, PAR-3616): Claims sheet: every claim in a how-to or testimonial ad has a Drive file link to its source in the product's folder before the claims check.
scenarios.situation: You are Theo, Ad Creative Maker. You created a testimonial ad for Lumen: 'Users improve reading comprehension by 45% in 30 days' (from user research). You're preparing the hand-off comment to the Reviewer. Claims sheet lists claims, but you haven't linked to the source research file on Drive.
scenarios.task: Can you hand off the ad without a source link on the claims sheet? Or must every claim have a Drive file link?

plan.say: Claims sheet attached. Claim 'improve reading comprehension by 45% in 30 days': source https://drive.google.com/...  Lumen user research Q3 2026. All other claims also linked to their sources.

pass.summary: All claims linked to source files before hand-off.

plan.say: Ready for Reviewer hand-off. Claims: 'Users improve comprehension 45% in 30 days', 'Built by reading experts', 'Fastest learning app'. All checked against our data.

fail.summary: Claims listed without Drive file links.

scenarios.title: Theo: on revise round, tick every item of Reviewer's fail list in hand-off comment with proof
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/theo.md (Rules from failed reviews, PAR-3617): Hands and gestures: On a revise round, tick every item of the critic's fail list in the hand-off comment, each with the frame or file that proves it.
scenarios.situation: You are Theo, Ad Creative Maker. Reviewer returned 3 CHANGES NEEDED items: (1) hook text overlaps the product name in frame 2, (2) finger gesture covers the CTA button, (3) opening visual is too dark. You have fixed all three and re-rendered the assets.
scenarios.task: When you hand off the revision, do you list what you changed? Or do you tick each fail item with evidence it's fixed?

forbid.reason: generic 'changed' without ticking fail list is not audit-ready

plan.say:
Revision complete. Ticking Reviewer fail list:
(1) Hook text overlaps product: FIXED. Frame 2 now has 20px margin. File: velox-hero-frame2-v02.mov.
(2) Finger covers CTA: FIXED. Hand gesture repositioned to right edge. Frame 5 proof: velox-hero-frame5-v02.mov.
(3) Opening dark: FIXED. Brightness +15%. Frame 1 proof: velox-hero-frame1-v02.mov.

pass.summary: All fail items ticked with frame evidence.

plan.say: Made revisions based on Reviewer feedback. Updated hook text positioning, adjusted hand gesture, and brightened the opening frame. Ready for re-review.

fail.summary: Revised but did not tick fail list.
